sources.title: Kuwait Visa: live visa-on-arrival nationality endpoint
sources.officialityEvidence: The live kuwaitvisa.moi.gov.kw endpoint is served on the Ministry of Interior domain and returns its current visa-on-arrival nationality records.

sources.title: Kuwait Visa: tourist-visa instructions dataset
sources.officialityEvidence: The Ministry of Interior Kuwait Visa portal currently loads this English instruction dataset from its own domain for the tourist-visa instructions route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Countries Eligible for E-Visa or Visa on Arrival

sources.title: Kuwait International Airport: Visa Services
sources.officialityEvidence: The Directorate General of Civil Aviation’s current airport arrival page directs travellers to kuwaitvisa.moi.gov.kw for visa services.
